text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
What heavy rain...
Naturally, the course won't be usable today, will it...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... It's so hazy from the fog
that even the view outside is clouded over...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"...Maybe I'll make a teru teru bozu
with Spe-chan or something."
Silence Suzuka seemed displeased that she wasn't able to go on her daily jog today.
